title: Record a prepayment
summary: Create → Prepayment: money the patient leaves on account; it's used later to pay invoices.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Prepayment
steps.details: Opens the prepayment form. It needs an open cash register.

steps.title: Payment method
steps.details: Cash adds to the cash count.

steps.title: Save the prepayment
steps.details: It stays as the patient's credit balance.
